# HP

> HP is a leading technology company offering AI-powered laptops, desktops, printers, monitors, and enterprise solutions for consumers and businesses.

HP's product portfolio spans personal computing devices featuring AI integration, printing and imaging solutions with subscription services, collaboration tools through HP Poly, and specialized workstations. The company emphasizes subscription-based service models and cutting-edge AI technology across its product lines.

## Key Topics

- AI PCs
- Copilot+ PCs
- OmniBook
- EliteBook
- HP Z Workstations
- HP Instant Ink
- HP All-In Plan
- HP Laptop Subscription
- Windows 11
- HP Monitors
- DesignJet
- HP Poly
- Workforce Experience Platform
- Device Management
- Subscription Services

## AI & Next-Generation Computing

- [AI PCs - HP's Next Gen AI PCs, Computers, and Laptops](https://www.hp.com/us-en/ai-solutions/next-gen-ai-pcs.html): HP AI PCs featuring OmniBook, EliteBook, and Copilot+ PC technology
- [Microsoft Copilot+ PCs For Business](https://www.hp.com/us-en/software/microsoft-copilot-pcs-for-business.html): HP Microsoft Copilot+ PCs for business with Windows 11 and AI features
- [Z Software & Solutions - Workstation Software](https://www.hp.com/us-en/workstations/software-solutions-workstation-pc.html): HP Z workstation software solutions including AI Studio and remote access

## Laptops, Desktops & Displays

- [Laptop Computers, Desktops, Printers, Ink & Toner | HP Official Site](https://www.hp.com/us-en/home.html): HP homepage showcasing laptops, desktops, printers, and accessories
- [HP Monitors - 4K Gaming & Business Displays](https://www.hp.com/us-en/shop/slp/hp-monitors): HP monitors catalog: 4K gaming and business displays from 24" to 34"
- [HP Accessories](https://www.hp.com/us-en/shop/cat/accessories-88342--1): HP accessories for laptops, printers, and peripherals including HyperX

## Subscription & Purchasing Programs

- [PC Subscription with Monthly Payment Plans | HP Laptop Subscription](https://hplaptopsubscription.hp.com): HP Laptop Subscription service with monthly payments and device upgrade options
- [HP All-In Plan – Printer Plans](https://www.hp.com/us-en/all-in-plan/printers.html): HP All-In Plan printer subscription with ink and 24/7 support
- [HP Instant Ink – Printer Ink Subscription](https://www.hp.com/us-en/printers/instant-ink.html): HP Instant Ink subscription service with automatic ink delivery and recycling

## Printing & Imaging Solutions

- [HP Large-format printers and plotters](https://www.hp.com/us-en/printers/large-format.html): HP large-format printers: DesignJet, PageWide XL, Latex, and Stitch
- [Ink Toner & Paper - HP Store](https://www.hp.com/us-en/shop/cat/ink--toner---paper): HP ink, toner, and paper supplies with HP Rewards and Instant Ink

## Enterprise & Collaboration Solutions

- [HP Poly Video & Voice Solutions - Formerly Polycom & Plantronics](https://www.hp.com/us-en/poly.html): HP Poly collaboration solutions for video conferencing and unified communications
- [HP Workforce Experience Platform | Optimize Your Workforce](https://workforceexperience.hp.com): HP Workforce Experience Platform for endpoint management and AI automation
